name: 02131 · Roslindale, MA
findings: ZIP 02131 (Roslindale) has 135 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02131 (Roslindale) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02131 (Roslindale) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02131 (Roslindale) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Health care organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 9 health care organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do health care organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: No religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.
